free_tier.stated: No free tier for text inference. Individual Lite USD 6/month (CNY 39) for 4.1 billion Credits; Standard USD 16, Pro USD 50, Max USD 100. TTS models are free for a limited time and do not consume Credits.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: an API key against OpenAI-compatible endpoints; OpenCode, OpenClaw and Claude Code are named
chaining: monthly Credits are the scarce link; when exhausted the service suspends until an upgrade or a switch to pay-as-you-go

limits.value: 4.1 billion to 82 billion Credits per month by tier
monthly quota does not roll over; service suspends on exhaustion

identity_cost.detail: a Xiaomi MiMo account and a purchased Token Plan; exact signup identity fields not verified

reliability_note: MiMo-V2.5-Pro and V2.5 were retired on 2026-10-21; the plan suspends when the monthly quota is exhausted and cannot draw the account balance

evidence.proved: the Lite individual plan is USD 6 per month with no free text tier
the fixed monthly Credits are stated for each tier

evidence.quote: When the monthly total quota of the package is used up, the system will suspend the service and will not continue to deduct from your bonus or account balance.
evidence.proved: the service suspends when the monthly quota is used up

notes: Paid-only. The three regional ids share the same first-party Token Plan price page; they differ only in API endpoint region.
